Experience the full Hindi action movie "Jeet" in glorious 4K quality on your TV! Starring Sunny Deol, Karisma Kapoor, and Salman Khan, this film is a must-watch for action movie fans.
A hitman working for a crime boss falls for a woman but she is married off to her childhood friend. Later, when the woman's and her husband's life comes under threat from the crime boss, the hitman becomes their protector.
Jeet is a 1996 Indian Hindi-language romantic action film written and directed by Raj Kanwar. The film stars Sunny Deol, Salman Khan, Karisma Kapoor, Amrish Puri and Tabu.
